newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Adflex raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Adflex raised to buy.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Jon van Bronkhorst has raised his rating on shares of Adflex Solutions Inc to buy from long term attractive.
-- In a statement, van Bronkhorst said he is impressed by the support Adflex's largest customers have given the comnpany as it moves subassembly operations to Thailand from the United Kingdom.
-- Van Bronkhorst believes the stock will trade higher "as the company makes progress rebuilding its financial model."
-- Adflex shares were up 3/8 to 11-1/8 in mid-morning exchange trade.
